blocks.title: Divide and conquer
blocks.text: Divide and conquer bare masle ko chhote, milte julte hisson mein torta, har hissa alag hal karta, aur un ke hal mila kar asal masla hal karta hai.

Merge Sort iski mashhoor misal hai: be-tarteeb list ko do aadhon mein baantein, har aadha tarteeb dein, phir dono tarteeb shuda aadhe jor kar aakhri tarteeb wali list banayein. Merge Sort O(n log n) waqt leta hai.

blocks.alt: Neele dabbon ka merge sort darakht: [14, 7, 3, 12] ko [14, 7] aur [3, 12] mein baanta gaya; phir har ek ko akeli cheezon 14, 7 aur 3, 12 mein; sab se neeche tarteeb wali list 3, 7, 12, 14.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.6: Merge sort ka amal (kitab ki Figure 3.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; [14, 7] ke neeche akeli cheezein 14, 7 dikhai gayi hain).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki figure mein [14, 7] ko baantne ke baad neeche 7 aur 14 ulti tarteeb mein chhape hain. Baantne (divide) se tarteeb nahi badalti, is liye yahan 14 aur 7 banaye gaye hain. Phir jorne (merge) ka marhala aata hai jo figure mein alag nahi dikhaya gaya: [14] aur [7] mil kar [7, 14], [3] aur [12] mil kar [3, 12], aur aakhir mein dono mil kar [3, 7, 12, 14].

blocks.prompt: Kis algorithm ki time complexity O(n log n) hai: Bubble Sort, Binary Search, Merge Sort ya Insertion Sort (MCQ 10)?
blocks.explanation: (c) Merge Sort. Binary search O(log n) hai; bubble aur insertion sort O(n^2).

items: Baanto, hisse hal karo, jor do; merge sort [14, 7, 3, 12] se [3, 7, 12, 14], O(n log n).
